verdict.rationale: Moss documents project-level API keys that can be created, listed, deleted and rotated via the CLI, plus a pattern for keeping the projectKey out of browser or untrusted clients. Nothing in the pack shows role-based access or per-index/per-collection permission scoping, so only the API-key part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: roles/RBAC, per-index (collection) permissions, scoped or read-only keys, independent corroboration.
